changelog:
Curate the catalog: the two menu entries that did nothing now work.

(v0.2.9 was tagged and its build failed the repository gate before publishing
anything; spec/54 makes tags immutable and a burned number is never reused, so
this is the same work under the next number.)

**Categories and Content languages**
- Both entries in the More menu did nothing when tapped. Everything behind them
  was already built and tested — the screens, the queries, the filters — and the
  menu simply had no branch to open them, so the flag flipped and the display did
  not change. Both now open.
- The category list is ordered the way you would expect: anything you have
  favourited pins to the top, then enabled categories, then the rest by name.
  Before this it was alphabetical only, so unticking a category left it exactly
  where it was among the eight hundred and looked like nothing had happened.
- You can favourite a category to pin it. Favouriting a category does **not**
  favourite the channels inside it — those are two different lists, and pinning a
  category to find it quickly should not put three thousand channels in your
  favourites.
- Select All and Unselect All now say what they are doing while they do it, and
  the buttons are disabled until it finishes. That action touches every channel
  in the catalog, and it used to be a silent screen.
- Both pickers now say how they stack: languages narrow the whole catalog first,
  then categories curate what is left. Without that, unticking a language and
  then wondering why a category has vanished is a puzzle.

**The release itself**
- The release now refuses to publish an APK signed by a different key than the one
  that signed the last one. That change cannot be undone once it is public — it
  forces everyone to uninstall and lose all their data — and until now nothing
  checked it. The existing checks only proved the keystore could be opened, which
  a completely different but valid keystore would also pass.
- The update prompt can open the release page, so you can read what is in a
  version before installing it.
- Pushing a version tag from a detached checkout is now refused before it leaves
  the machine, rather than failing in CI after the tag is already public.

Known limits: multi-view, picture-in-picture, DVR and recording are not in this
build. Catch-up still has not been tested against a real provider archive. The
language picker lives under More rather than Settings until Settings gains its
group structure.
